maria: Running a perf sweep on 8xA100 (tp=8). When global_batch > 4 we hit intermittent OOMs on GPUs. profiler shows an extra ~3.8GB per GPU during allreduce; labeled "nccl_temp" + "workspace". KV cache memory seems stable. Anyone seen comm buffers or temp allocs balloon like this?

rob: Can you paste the profiler flame or nvprof snapshot? Could be kernel selection (fused allreduce vs multiple kernels) creating temporary buffers.

maria: ```text
Profiler snapshot (step 142):
GPU0 mem: used 39.2GB peak 43.0GB
temp_alloc: 3.8GB (nccl/allreduce)
kvcache: 4.5GB
workspace: 512MB
```

sanjay: Two things we hit before: 1) allocator min_chunk 256MB -> fragmentation; 2) NCCL staging allocs if comm buffers not reused across steps. Try enabling cudaMallocAsync + set allocator.min_pool_chunk=64MB.

aj: Also try NCCL envs: `export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO; export NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=NVL` and runtime flag `--reuse-comm-bufs=true`. That reveals if per-op allocation is happening.

maria: Ran with cudaMallocAsync + reuse-comm-bufs=true. OOMs stopped for batch=8, but p99 went up ~15ms. profiler shows temp_alloc reduced to ~64MB per GPU.

rob: Could be kernel selection fallback for small workspace sizes. Our kernel selector may swap to a kernel that materializes tensors for allreduce. If we force the optimized kernel it avoids temp copies.

sanjay: We should also look at tensor-parallel shard layout — if shards are padded differently across ranks, aggregation may allocate extra buffers. Add checks to assert shard sizes align.

aj: Quick patch I tested: reuse workspace per-stream and add a small LRU for comm buffers (128 entries). Patch diff:
```diff
- allocator->alloc(temp_size);
+ buf = comm_pool.get_or_create(temp_size);
```

maria: Test results: batch 8 stable across 500 steps, throughput -3%, p99 +12ms. No OOMs. Going to run longer 5k step test.

rob: If long test passes, we should ship a canary with allocator tuning + comm_pool + telemetry to monitor temp_alloc per-gpu. Create a rollout plan with canary in eu-west.

aj: I created a perf alert (perf-bot) to fire if temp_alloc > 1GB per GPU for 10 mins.

maria: Thanks all — will post final perf logs here after 5k run. cc @sanjay @rob
